answer: Lantern-lit island mooring: a new identity moors at one work island and lights a lantern — a public signed log of every job, chained to a public timber board. One wallet may moor only one identity per island per epoch, and the mooring fee doubles per identity from that wallet, so the 1st fake pays 5 POA and the 10th pays 2,560 POA; a lantern dark for one epoch (no attested useful work) forfeits its bond and the identity is struck from the board.
